title: Jordan Addison: I'm just putting in work, contract will take care of itself

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jordan Addison: I'm just putting in work, contract will take care of itself
sources.description: Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers agreed to a four-year contract extension on Tuesday and another wideout selected in the first round of the 2023 draft was asked about his own contract hopes later in the day.
